errors.invoice.line_amount_underflow: One of the lines prices to 0.00, so no invoice was issued. Quantities are sent in millionths of a unit (one unit is 1000000): check the quantity of that line.
errors.invoice.tax_quota_mismatch: The tax quota does not match the base and the rate declared for it, so no invoice was issued. Charging one amount and declaring another breaks the check the tax authority performs.
errors.invoice.totals_mismatch: The invoice total does not add up to its own lines, so nothing was issued.
errors.invoice.negative_total: An ordinary invoice cannot total less than zero. To return an amount, issue a corrective invoice.
errors.invoice.f1_requires_customer_tax_id: A complete invoice (F1) needs the customer's tax ID: without it the tax authority rejects it (error 1189) and the document is really a simplified ticket. Issue it with the customer's tax ID, or use a simplified-ticket series (F2).

setup.title: Your invoice numbering
setup.description: Check the prefix your invoice numbers will carry, and add the separate series the tax authority requires for corrective invoices. If you are coming from another system, continue its numbering instead of starting again at 1.

ui.aeatNoRecord: Not sent to the AEAT yet.
ui.qrValidateNote: Scan to validate the invoice at the AEAT
ui.rectifyNote: An R1 corrective invoice (RECT series) with negated amounts will be issued and the original invoice will be cancelled. This operation cannot be undone.
ui.errMarkPaidStatus: Only an issued invoice can be marked as paid.
ui.errRectifyRectifying: A corrective invoice cannot be rectified.
ui.seriesIntro: Each series defines the prefix and counter of the invoice numbering (PREFIX-YYYY-NNNNNN) per invoice type (F1, F2, …). The code, year and counter are immutable for fiscal integrity; only the name, prefix, active state and default flag can be edited.
ui.seriesEmpty: No series yet. Create the first one to number your invoices.
ui.codeHint: Internal identifier of the series (immutable once created).
ui.prefixHint: Optional text prepended to the number (e.g. FAC → FAC-2026-000001).
ui.formatHint: Placeholders: {prefix}, {code}, {year}, {seq} and {seq:01d}…{seq:09d}. Leave empty for PREFIX-YYYY-NNNNNN. Anything else is written literally (e.g. VFT{year}-A-{seq:04d}).
ui.formatLockedHint: This series has already issued invoices, so its number format can no longer be changed: the number is part of the VeriFactu chain. Create a new series if you need a different format.
ui.settingsIntro: Manage invoice numbering here through series.
